name: Sparse Field Training
definition: A training strategy for value regression MLPs that uses an existing VDB grid (OpenVDB or NanoVDB) to randomly sample only active voxels during each epoch, explicitly excluding inactive/background values to introduce sparsity and focus learning capacity on significant content.
summary: Sparse Field Training restricts MLP training to active VDB voxels, excluding background data to focus learning on significant content and implicitly encode the grid's adaptive structure.
